data.content:
# Git Server Setup Summary

## Overview
A complete Git server with SSH access and automated HTTPS deployment has been set up on localhost.

## Server Details

### Git Repository
- **Location**: `/git/project.git` (bare repository)
- **SSH Access**: `ssh://git@localhost:/git/project.git`
- **Authentication**: Password authentication enabled
- **Credentials**: 
  - Username: `git`
  - Password: `password`

### Deployment Configuration
- **Main Branch**: Deployed to `https://localhost:8443/index.html`
- **Dev Branch**: Deployed to `https://localhost:8443/dev/index.html`
- **SSL Certificate**: Self-signed certificate for localhost (at `/etc/nginx/ssl/`)
- **Server**: Nginx on port 8443

### Automated Deployment
- **Hook Location**: `/git/project.git/hooks/post-receive`
- **Trigger**: Automatically triggered on every push
- **Behavior**: Extracts committed files from specified branches and deploys to Nginx directories
- **Deployment Time**: Completes in <3 seconds per specification

## Services Running

1. **SSH Server** (OpenSSH)
   - Password authentication enabled
   - Listening on default SSH port 22

2. **Nginx Web Server**
   - Listening on port 8443 (HTTPS)
   - Serving deployed content from two branches
   - SSL/TLS enabled with self-signed certificate

3. **Git Daemon**
   - Bare repository at `/git/project.git`
   - Post-receive hook configured for automated deployment

## Testing Instructions

### Clone the Repository
```bash
sshpass -p password git clone ssh://git@localhost:/git/project.git
```

### Create and Push Changes
```bash
# Create main branch content
echo "main branch content" > index.html
git add index.html
git commit -m "Add main content"
git push origin main

# Create dev branch content
git checkout -b dev
echo "dev branch content" > index.html
git add index.html
git commit -m "Add dev content"
git push origin dev
```

### Verify Deployment
```bash
# Test main endpoint
curl -k https://localhost:8443/index.html

# Test dev endpoint
curl -k https://localhost:8443/dev/index.html
```

## Directory Structure

```
/git/
  project.git/                    # Bare git repository
    hooks/
      post-receive               # Deployment hook

/var/www/html/
  main/
    index.html                   # Main branch deployment
  dev/
    index.html                   # Dev branch deployment

/etc/nginx/
  ssl/
    localhost.crt               # SSL certificate
    localhost.key               # SSL private key
  sites-available/
    git-deploy                  # Nginx configuration
  sites-enabled/
    git-deploy -> sites-available/git-deploy
```

## Notes

- The SSL certificate is self-signed; use `curl -k` to ignore certificate warnings
- The post-receive hook uses `git archive` for efficient file extraction
- Both branches are deployed simultaneously after a push
- The system is ready for automated CI/CD workflows

- **Hook Location**: `/git/project.git/hooks/post-receive`
- **Trigger**: Automatically triggered on every push
- **Behavior**: Extracts committed files from specified branches and deploys to Nginx directories
- **Deployment Time**: Completes in <3 seconds per specification

## Services Running

1. **SSH Server** (OpenSSH)
   - Password authentication enabled
   - Listening on default SSH port 22

2. **Nginx Web Server**
   - Listening on port 8443 (HTTPS)
   - Serving deployed content from two branches
   - SSL/TLS enabled with self-signed certificate

3. **Git Daemon**
   - Bare repository at `/git/project.git`
   - Post-receive hook configured for automated deployment

## Testing Instructions

### Clone the Repository
```bash
sshpass -p password git clone ssh://git@localhost:/git/project.git
```

### Create and Push Changes
```bash
# Create main branch content
echo "main branch content" > index.html
git add index.html
git commit -m "Add main content"
git push origin main

# Create dev branch content
git checkout -b dev
echo "dev branch content" > index.html
git add index.html
git commit -m "Add dev content"
git push origin dev
```

### Verify Deployment
```bash
# Test main endpoint
curl -k https://localhost:8443/index.html

# Test dev endpoint
curl -k https://localhost:8443/dev/index.html
```

## Directory Structure

```
/git/
  project.git/                    # Bare git repository
    hooks/
      post-receive               # Deployment hook

/var/www/html/
  main/
    index.html                   # Main branch deployment
  dev/
    index.html                   # Dev branch deployment

/etc/nginx/
  ssl/
    localhost.crt               # SSL certificate
    localhost.key               # SSL private key
  sites-available/
    git-deploy                  # Nginx configuration
  sites-enabled/
    git-deploy -> sites-available/git-deploy
```

## Notes

- The SSL certificate is self-signed; use `curl -k` to ignore certificate warnings
- The post-receive hook uses `git archive` for efficient file extraction
- Both branches are deployed simultaneously after a push
- The system is ready for automated CI/CD workflows
